transcription.source: Claude (Opus 5.5) for Brice Dudout, 17 Nov 2026: two passes on different crops by the same reader, arbitrated on the image
transcription.notes: Digitised microfilm (DDB / Archivportal-D IIIF, region crops at 3500 px). Blot and hole on lines 1, 7-8, 20, 24, 26-28. Pass differences: transcription/pass_differences.md.

system.summary: Two-digit numbers for letters, a=11 ... z=34 in alphabetical order (24 letters), written contiguously with dots between words; 38 and 39 as second o and u; overbar doubles a letter.
system.notes: The key strip on view 11 gives 11-34; 38 and 39 are deduced from the sheet. One number 398 on a slip is off the key.

prior_solution.where: Key strip on view 11 of the same file; no reading found in the repository or in print

solution.what: 68 views of D 4 Nr. 76/6 fetched from the DDB IIIF server; region crops of view 13 at full resolution.
Key strip a=11 ... z=34 found on view 11 of the same file.
Two passes on different crops, arbitrated on the image (transcription/).
Key applied to the whole sheet: 667 of 682 numbers in 11-34; 38 and 39 deduced as o and u from 14 contexts; continuous German.
124 words: 95 sure, 18 probable or restored, 11 unresolved (reading.md as of 17 Nov 2026).
Repository (Arcinsys record only), quick web search and own folders: no reading or edition found.

Blind shape check of 15 boxed numbers on the microfilm (12 targets, 3 controls, 3 of 3 as expected), answered by Brice Dudout (blind_check/, sheet of 17 Nov 2026). gräfliche and dapffer made sure (97 sure, 16 probable or restored, 11 unresolved of 124); the last number of entsetzung seen as 27 (r), not 17 (g), so the word stays probable; the end of gesch... seen as 27 ... 22, no word; tag, mittwoch and also left open by the remarks. No selection rule hashed before the answers, so not outcome.sign_check.

Second blind shape check of 9 boxed numbers (6 targets, 3 hidden controls, 3 of 3 as expected), answered by Brice Dudout on a new colour scan sent by HStA Darmstadt for private study (not seen here). mittwoch made sure (98 sure, 15 probable or restored, 11 unresolved of 124). The answers support geschossen (l. 24) and the spelling Hagenaw on the new scan, as reported by Brice Dudout; not counted here, since neither word is in this folder's transcription. decembris written decemmris (stays probable); the sign after it unresolved, no year read. 6 target signs, under the outcome.sign_check minimum.

texts.label: Letter on the relief of Philippsburg (HStAD D 4 Nr. 76/6, view 13)
texts.summary: The writer has been at Zabern pressing the Imperial and Spanish commanders for the relief of Philippsburg; regiments are on the march; officers and soldiers are to be encouraged to hold until New Year; their money is ready.

reading_review.by: integration review of PR #781 (AI agent, for the maintainers); not a person
reading_review.note: Known key from the same file; decryption reproduced from digits_arbitrated.txt (682 numbers, 667 in 11-34). Count recounted from reading.md: 124 words, 98 sure, 15 probable or restored, 11 unresolved (0.79). Blind shape checks answered by Brice Dudout (contributor): 18 Nov, 15 questions, 3 of 3 controls; 25 Nov on a private colour scan, 9 questions, 3 of 3 controls. Neither meets the outcome.sign_check minimum (no pre-hashed rule; 6 signs). Not a second reading against the image: the doubtful places on the public microfilm could not be settled by the reviewer, and the private scan was not seen.
